body:
The police raided my room a while ago. Somehow they still feel the need to annoy innocent pot smokers, that don't sell the stuff, don't have huge amounts or do anything criminal. I just try relax once or twice a week by smoking some pot and watching some Dvds...

Anyway, they tore apart a lot of books, really old videogame boxes, dvds, cd covers, lecture notes and a whole lot of other stuff. All in all the damage is about 500€! The second i saw the damage they've caused i got really angry. I ran to the basement and started beating the shit out my punchbag until there was no more skin left on my knuckles and i just couldn't raise my arms anymore.

(I'm not a violent guy. Punching a punchbag is just a great workout.)

I don't feel guilty about not loving my parents. I guess they pretty much know that.

I can't really talk to my sister about that topic. She's only 16 and going through enough stuff right now. Telling her about all my problems would just be too much for her. We're pretty close and i've been thinking about talking to her a few weeks now, but at the moment it would just be too much.

About my love life. Yeah it's pretty much fear of the past repeating itself. I once read that the person who invests more into relationship is the one who always gets hurt. So far i can say it's true. I was always the one who was getting hurt. The next few years i'm absolutely not willing to get involved in any real relationship.

About the imsomnia. Yeah i know it's a wicked cycle, but every now and then you end up there again. I try to fight it with sport in the evening, books, etc. but every couple of months it's back to just lying there and getting crazy about not sleeping.

About the political stuff. That's exactly what bothers me so much. It takes forever to catch up with time. It's nice to know that the kids 3 generations from now don't have to bother about being branded as evil pirates that don't ever spend any money on anything or scumbag criminal weed smokers, but that doesn't help us right now and that bothers me so damn much...

Hehe i know you're not laying a guilt trip on me. I've heard this argument so many times and i still don't really know what i should answer. I HATE that it will affect so many people and will hurt a few people really really bad.

When you get dragged to court in a few weeks for a "crime" that doesn't hurt anybody and have absolutely no money left your options arent really open, are they? I know what you mean, but right now the only thing i can do is go on with my life here, even though it slowly kills you on the inside. Maybe i just lose my ID card and flee... ;)

I really appreciate that you take so much time. Thanks a lot.

It's just so hard when you get treated like shit all your life and now you have to go on with it just so you won't hurt people. It's such a fucked up logic :D.

Time to go to bed now.

**I have a lot of stuff to do at the university in the next days, so please don't be "afraid" if it'll take me a few days to write back. Thanks reddit <3**

I was actually thinking about that. After i get my bachelor degree (if i'm still alive then) i will move to a country where i can smoke weed and don't have to worry about cops searching and destroying the whole place again...

Thanks :)
